definitions.explanation: One of the five digits on the hand. {指|ゆび} can refer to any finger, and specific fingers have their own names.
Also refers to toes on the foot. Toes are specifically called {足|あし}の{指|ゆび} (foot fingers/toes).

examples.japanese: {指|ゆび}を{切|き}ってしまいました。
その{方向|ほうこう}を{指|ゆび}で{指|さ}してください。
examples.english: Please point in that direction with your finger.

notes: Finger names: {親指|おやゆび} (thumb), {人差し指|ひとさしゆび} (index finger), {中指|なかゆび} (middle finger), {薬指|くすりゆび} (ring finger), {小指|こゆび} (little finger). The verb {指す|さす} (to point) uses the same kanji.
